claims.statement: The European Commission reports more than 58 million tonnes of annual EU food waste with an estimated EUR 132 billion market value.
Eurostat's 2023 sector table reports about 6.5 million tonnes from restaurants and food services and 4.5 million tonnes from retail and other food distribution in the EU.

Eurostat documents an annual, standardised reporting methodology for food waste by sector, showing that the loss category is measurable even though individual small businesses may not yet log it well.

contrary_evidence: Households generate more than half of EU food waste, so the headline market value substantially overstates the business-addressable portion.
Simple par levels and experienced managers may outperform a model when assortments and demand are stable.
Existing POS and inventory vendors can add basic forecasts and markdowns.

economics.acquisition_route: Run four weeks in shadow mode at 10-20 sites, compare recommendation error with manager forecasts, then let one POS vendor sell only where estimated annual waste supports a clear ROI.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Two thousand locations averaging 400 PLN monthly would create 9.6m PLN annual recurring revenue before savings fees. At a mature 35% owner-cash margin, 3.36m PLN per year could support cumulative distributions above 10m PLN over five mature years without sale proceeds.
economics.founder_time: Serve one category and one POS export at about 3 hours/day, with all production decisions remaining human-approved; keep employment through paid multi-site renewals and stated runway gates.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Forecasting and reporting are low-cost software, but POS connectors and rollout support matter; target 72-86% gross margin once a chain is onboarded.
economics.payback: Target customer payback within 2 months from reduced ingredient loss; labour and waste baselines must be agreed before the live test.
economics.pricing: Assumption to test: 250-900 PLN per site monthly plus 5-10% of verified ingredient-and-disposal savings above a conservative baseline; initial data setup 1500-5000 PLN per chain.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Production decisions recur daily and models learn each site; retained value depends on staff using the recommendations and recording exceptions.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A library of item shelf-life, substitution, weather, calendar and site-ramp effects improves cold starts and makes the system useful before a single site has years of clean data.
fingerprint.customer: Polish food businesses with 5-100 locations, perishable daily production and digital POS data but no central forecasting team.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Polish POS vendors, bakery ingredient wholesalers and franchise consultants resell the product, while a four-week shadow forecast serves as an asynchronous proof.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: POS-connected forecast that recommends conservative item quantities, captures simple waste counts, suggests timed markdowns and reports forecast error and avoided cost; subscription per site with an optional savings component.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The owner or operations director pays per location and optionally on measured waste-cost reduction; the existing recurring spend is ingredients, production labour, markdown and disposal for unsold goods.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Before each production shift, staff must set item quantities under uncertain demand, and at close they record or discard unsold food without a trusted cost-and-cause view.

founder_fit: Demand forecasting, uncertainty bounds and intervention measurement are core data-science work.
POS and wholesaler channels enable scalable regional distribution with limited founder-led networking.
A shadow-mode pilot avoids operational risk and can run alongside a full-time job.
The model monetises a measurable recurring loss with no inventory ownership or physical expansion.
risks: Underproduction can lose more gross profit and customer trust than waste savings create.
Savings claims may be confounded by price, assortment and promotion changes.
POS integrations can fragment implementation effort.
Low per-site revenue could create an uneconomic support burden without channel concentration.

structure.commercial_archetype: Per-location operational optimisation SaaS with verified-savings option
structure.control_point: The daily production quantity recommendation and close-of-day waste ledger
structure.critical_dependency: Consistent item-level POS and waste data plus staff adherence to recommendations and recording

thesis: Give multi-site bakeries, canteens, meal-prep operators and small grocers a simple daily production recommendation and verified waste-cost ledger driven by POS, weather, calendar and promotion data. These operators already buy ingredients and labour that become unsold waste; per-location software plus a modest verified-savings fee can align price to a recurring, countable loss.
title: Daily Production and Waste Forecaster for Small Food Chains
uncertainties: The typical waste cost and digital-data quality for Polish chains in each proposed segment are unknown.
Weather and event data may add little beyond recent sales for some categories.
Staff adherence, waste logging burden and the fair savings baseline need real pilots.
All price, margin, location-count and wealth figures are assumptions.
